narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms developed into northwestern Arkansas from the northwest during the afternoon of the 23rd, and additional thunderstorms developed across the area during the late afternoon and evening as a cold front moved through the region. The strongest storms produced large hail to ping pong ball size and damaging wind gusts. Locally heavy rainfall from these thunderstorms produced some flash flooding.
ev: Portions of Ernest Lancaster Drive near the airport were flooded.
Portions of several roads in and around town were flooded.
Portions of several roads were flooded in and around Altus.
Portions of several roads were flooded in and around Charleston, with flood water entering some residences.
Portions of Highway 23 north of Turners Bend were flooded.
